name: Playmind
summary: Engineered an autonomous in-game intelligence platform with real-time conversational assistance, tactical memory, and low-latency interaction loops.
description: Playmind is an autonomous intelligence platform built directly into competitive gaming pipelines. By translating real-time telemetry into low-latency conversational cues and spatial memory anchors, we created an interface that remains perceptually invisible until called upon.

gallery.caption: Real-time in-game HUD overlay responding to live tactical audio feeds.
Display and HUD spatial telemetry anchor layouts.
Cross-platform design tokens mapped across WebGL and native views.
Memory inspection and low-latency interaction loops.
Sub-pixel tactical audio pulse cues and spring physics.

name: IKEA
summary: Co-designed and maintained the AR toolset within retailer apps for IKEA worldwide, making interior design tools available for the many. Commissioned by Bakken & Baeck.
description: Bringing spatial interior design tools directly to everyday customers without requiring LiDAR hardware. Co-designed and maintained the AR toolset within IKEA retailer apps worldwide, establishing natural room scanning motions and realistic lighting models.

gallery.caption: AR room surface detection and spatial guidance interaction loops.
3D model placement grid and floor plane anchoring.
Material shader preview and real-time lighting calculation.
Room perimeter dimensional annotations and boundary limits.
Complete end-to-end furniture staging and AR inspection loop.
